sections.scene: Midnight inside a nearly empty roadside diner. <Subject 1>, a private investigator with a damp wool coat, sits opposite <Subject 2>, an exhausted night waitress, beneath a flickering sign.
sections.shot_list: 0.00-1.40s: hold both subjects across the booth. 1.40-3.30s: <Subject 2> slides a sealed envelope across the table. 3.30s-end: <Subject 1> stops it with two fingers and looks up.
sections.acting: Use quiet micro-performance: guarded eye contact, one controlled breath and precise hand contact with the envelope. Both subjects remain seated.
sections.dialogue: <Subject 2> (S2): <d>[English] You were never here.</d> <Subject 1> answers only with a small nod.
sections.light_and_image: Green-blue window spill, warm tungsten practicals, rain traces on glass, natural skin exposure and subtle film grain.
sections.camera: One slow push across table height, maintaining the two-shot until the final emphasis on <Subject 1>; no reverse angle and no cut.
sections.production_sound: Rain against glass, refrigerator hum, distant tire wash, ceramic cup resonance, paper sliding and intimate booth dialogue.
sections.non_diegetic_music: No score until the envelope stops; then one almost inaudible brushed-cymbal swell.
sections.negatives: No lip-sync drift, no duplicated hands, no changing envelope, no added customers, no neon color shift, no jump cut, no captions.
